description: An open-source, privacy-first, self-hosted knowledge workspace where humans and AI agents work together 开源、隐私优先、自托管的知识工作空间，让人与智能体在此协作

sources.entry: SiYuan - A privacy-first personal knowledge management software, written in typescript and golang. (Source Code) AGPL-3.0 Docker/Go
SiYuan | Privacy-first personal knowledge management system

summary.one_liner: SiYuan is a privacy-first, self-hosted personal knowledge management app with block-level references, Markdown WYSIWYG editing, and an agent-friendly CLI and API.
summary.what_it_does: SiYuan is a block-based note-taking and knowledge workspace built around fine-grained block-level references and two-way links. Its editor supports Markdown WYSIWYG, list outlines, block zoom-in, and editing of very large documents, plus math, charts, flowcharts, Gantt charts and staves. Content can be exported as standard Markdown with assets, PDF, Word, or HTML, and includes a table view database, flashcard spaced repetition, and OpenAI API-based AI writing and Q/A. A built-in CLI gives scripts and agents direct access to workspace data for notebooks, documents, search (including asset-file content), SQL queries, and sync. The Docker deployment runs it as a browser-accessed server with a lock-screen password or OIDC login.
use_cases: Self-hosting a private notes server accessed through a browser
Linking and referencing ideas at the block level
Exporting notes to Markdown, PDF, Word or HTML
Scripting or automating workspace data via the command-line interface
how_to_run: Install the desktop or mobile app from the App Market, Installation Package, or Package Manager listed in the README

For a server: docker run -d -v /siyuan/workspace:/siyuan/workspace -p 6806:6806 -e PUID=1001 -e PGID=1002 b3log/siyuan serve --workspace=/siyuan/workspace/ --accessAuthCode="${AuthCode:?Set AuthCode}" (set AuthCode first to a strong password)
Or use the Docker Compose, Kubernetes (community HelmForge chart), Unraid, or TrueNAS templates in the README
CLI: create a symlink to the bundled kernel binary, then run e.g. siyuan notebook list -w ~/SiYuan
notable: Block-level references and two-way links with custom attributes and SQL query embeds
Command-line interface with search, export, sync and database commands, usable without a running server
Docker deployment with OIDC login support (custom, Google, Microsoft, GitHub) alongside a lock-screen password
Native apps for desktop, Android, iOS and HarmonyOS, plus a Chrome/Edge clipping extension
Encrypted notebooks and data-repo based cloud sync
caveats: Docker/server mode is browser-only: no desktop or mobile app connections, no PDF/HTML/Word export, and no Markdown file import
Third-party sync disks (Dropbox-style folder sync) are not supported; cloud storage requires a paid Members plan
Some features (including cloud storage) are limited to paid members; most others are free
